translations.literal: Sixth month, the Hun River overflowed and burst the Lugou River dike for more than 100 zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: the Hun River overflowed and burst the Lugou River dike for more than 100 zhang.

sentences.zh: 七月，北畿七府俱水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the seven prefectures of the Northern Metropolitan Region all had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: the seven prefectures of the Northern Metropolitan Region all flooded.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，南陽山水泛漲，沖決堤岸，漂流人畜廬舍。

translations.literal: Year 5, seventh month, mountain streams in Nanyang rose broadly, bursting dikes and sweeping away people, livestock, and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 5, seventh month: mountain streams in Nanyang rose broadly, bursting dikes and sweeping away people, livestock, and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，渾河溢，決徐家等口，順天、保定、真定、河間州縣二十九俱水。

translations.literal: Year 6, sixth month, the Hun River overflowed and burst at Xujia and other openings; twenty-nine prefectures and counties of Shuntian, Baoding, Zhending, and Hejian all had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 6, sixth month: the Hun River overflowed and burst at Xujia and other openings; twenty-nine prefectures and counties of Shuntian, Baoding, Zhending, and Hejian all flooded.

sentences.zh: 河決開封，沒八縣。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst at Kaifeng; eight counties were inundated.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst at Kaifeng and inundated eight counties.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，太原河、汾並溢，傷稼。

translations.literal: Year 7, sixth month, at Taiyuan the He and Fen Rivers both overflowed and damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 7, sixth month: at Taiyuan the He and Fen Rivers both overflowed and damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，江西瀕江八府江漲，漂沒民田，溺死男婦無算。

translations.literal: Year 8, sixth month, the eight prefectures along the river in Jiangxi had the Yangtze rise; commoners' fields were swept away; men and women drowned beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 8, sixth month: the eight riverine prefectures of Jiangxi saw the Yangtze rise, sweeping away commoners' fields and drowning men and women beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，沁鄉沁水漲，決馬曲灣，經獲嘉、新鄉，平地成河。

translations.literal: Year 9, first month, the Qin River at Qin township rose and burst at Maqu Bend; passing through Huojia and Xinxiang, level ground became a river.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 9, first month: the Qin River at Qin township rose and burst at Maqu Bend; passing through Huojia and Xinxiang, level ground became a river.

sentences.zh: 五月，寧海縣潮決，徙地百七十餘頃。

translations.literal: Fifth month, the tide burst at Ninghai county; more than 170 qing of land shifted.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: the tide burst at Ninghai county and shifted more than 170 qing of land.

sentences.zh: 六月，渾河決東岸，自狼河口至小屯廠，順天、順德、河間俱水。

translations.literal: Sixth month, the Hun River burst the east bank from Langhe mouth to Xiaotun works; Shuntian, Shunde, and Hejian all had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: the Hun River burst the east bank from Langhe mouth to Xiaotun works; Shuntian, Shunde, and Hejian all flooded.

sentences.zh: 七月，遼東大水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, great flood in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Liaodong suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 正統元年閏六月，順天、真定、保定、濟南、開封、彰德六府俱大水。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 1, intercalary sixth month, the six prefectures Shuntian, Zhending, Baoding, Jinan, Kaifeng, and Zhangde all had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 1, intercalary sixth month: Shuntian, Zhending, Baoding, Jinan, Kaifeng, and Zhangde—the six prefectures—all suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 二年，鳳陽、淮安、揚州諸府，徐、和、滁諸州，河南開封，四五月河、淮泛漲，漂居民禾稼。

translations.literal: Year 2, the prefectures Fengyang, Huai'an, and Yangzhou, the prefectures Xu, He, and Chu, and Kaifeng in Henan—in the fourth and fifth months the Huang and Huai rose broadly; residents and crops were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 2: Fengyang, Huai'an, and Yangzhou prefectures, Xu, He, and Chu prefectures, and Kaifeng in Henan—in the fourth and fifth months the Huang and Huai rose broadly and swept away residents and crops.

sentences.zh: 九月，河決陽武、原武、滎澤。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the Yellow River burst at Yangwu, Yuanwu, and Xingze.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: the Yellow River burst at Yangwu, Yuanwu, and Xingze.

sentences.zh: 湖廣沿江六縣大水決江堤。

translations.literal: Along the river in Huguang six counties had great flooding and burst the Yangtze dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Along the river in Huguang six counties suffered great flooding and burst the Yangtze dikes.

sentences.zh: 三年，陽武河決，武陟沁決，廣平、順德漳決，通州白河溢。

translations.literal: Year 3, the Yellow River burst at Yangwu; the Qin burst at Wuzhi; the Zhang burst at Guangping and Shunde; the Bai River overflowed at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 3: the Yellow River burst at Yangwu; the Qin burst at Wuzhi; the Zhang burst at Guangping and Shunde; the Bai River overflowed at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，京師大水，壞官舍民居三千三百九十區。

translations.literal: Year 4, fifth month, great flood in the capital; 3,390 government and private dwellings were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 4, fifth month: a great flood in the capital damaged 3,390 government and private dwellings.

sentences.zh: 順天、真定、保定三府州縣及開封、衛輝、彰德三府俱大水。

translations.literal: The three prefectures and counties of Shuntian, Zhending, and Baoding and the three prefectures Kaifeng, Weihui, and Zhangde all had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian, Zhending, and Baoding prefectures and counties and Kaifeng, Weihui, and Zhangde prefectures all suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 七月，滹沱、沁、漳三水俱決，壞饒陽、獻縣、衛輝、彰德堤岸。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the Hutuo, Qin, and Zhang rivers all burst; dikes at Raoyang, Xian county, Weihui, and Zhangde were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: the Hutuo, Qin, and Zhang rivers all burst, damaging dikes at Raoyang, Xian county, Weihui, and Zhangde.

sentences.zh: 八月，白溝、渾河二水溢，決保定安州堤。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the Baigou and Hun rivers overflowed and burst the dikes at Baoding and Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: the Baigou and Hun rivers overflowed and burst the dikes at Baoding and Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 蘇、常、鎮三府俱決，款饒陽、獻縣、衛輝、彰德堤岸。

translations.literal: Su, Chang, and Zhen prefectures all burst; at Raoyang, Xian county, Weihui, and Zhangde the dikes were breached.
translations.idiomatic: Su, Chang, and Zhen prefectures all burst; at Raoyang, Xian county, Weihui, and Zhangde the dikes were breached.

sentences.zh: 九月，滹沱復決深州，淹百餘里。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the Hutuo burst again at Shenzhou, inundating more than 100 li.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: the Hutuo burst again at Shenzhou, inundating more than 100 li.

sentences.zh: 五年五月至七月，江西江溢，河南河溢。

translations.literal: Year 5, fifth month through seventh month, the Yangtze in Jiangxi overflowed; rivers in Henan overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 5, fifth month through seventh month: the Yangtze in Jiangxi overflowed and rivers in Henan overflowed.

sentences.zh: 八月，潮決蕭山海塘。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the tide burst the seawall at Xiaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: the tide burst the seawall at Xiaoshan.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，泗州水溢丈餘，漂廬舍。

translations.literal: Year 6, fifth month, at Sizhou water rose more than a zhang; dwellings were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 6, fifth month: at Sizhou water rose more than a zhang and swept away dwellings.

sentences.zh: 七月，白河決武清、淳阝縣堤二十二處。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the Bai River burst the dikes at Wuqing and Juancheng counties in twenty-two places.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: the Bai River burst the dikes at Wuqing and Juancheng counties in twenty-two places.

sentences.zh: 八月，寧夏久雨，水泛，壞屯堡墩臺甚衆。

translations.literal: Eighth month, at Ningxia long rains; water spread; very many stockades, forts, and beacon towers were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: at Ningxia long rains spread water and damaged very many stockades, forts, and beacon towers.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，渾河決固安。

translations.literal: Year 8, sixth month, the Hun River burst at Gu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 8, sixth month: the Hun River burst at Gu'an.

sentences.zh: 八月，台州、鬆門、海門海潮泛溢，壞城郭、官亭、民舍、軍器。

translations.literal: Eighth month, sea tides at Taizhou, Songmen, and Haimen spread broadly; city walls, official pavilions, dwellings, and military equipment were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: sea tides at Taizhou, Songmen, and Haimen spread broadly, damaging city walls, official pavilions, dwellings, and military equipment.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，揚子江沙洲潮水溢漲，高丈五六尺，溺男女千餘人。

translations.literal: Year 9, seventh month, tides on the sandbars of the Yangtze at Yangzhou rose more than one or five-six chi; more than 1,000 men and women drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 9, seventh month: tides on the Yangtze sandbars at Yangzhou rose one to five or six chi, drowning more than 1,000 men and women.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，北畿七府及應天、濟南、岳州、嘉興、湖州、台州俱大水。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, the seven prefectures of the Northern Metropolitan Region and Yingtian, Jinan, Yuezhou, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Taizhou all had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary seventh month: the seven prefectures of the Northern Metropolitan Region and Yingtian, Jinan, Yuezhou, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Taizhou all suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 河南山水灌衛河，沒衛輝、開封、懷慶、彰德民舍，壞衛所城。

translations.literal: Mountain streams in Henan poured into the Wei River, inundating dwellings at Weihui, Kaifeng, Huaiqing, and Zhangde and damaging guard-city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain streams in Henan poured into the Wei River, inundating dwellings at Weihui, Kaifeng, Huaiqing, and Zhangde and damaging guard-city walls.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，洪洞汾水堤決，移置普潤驛以遠其害。

translations.literal: Year 10, third month, the Fen River dike at Hongtong burst; the Purun post station was moved to keep distant from the harm.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 10, third month: the Fen River dike at Hongtong burst; the Purun post station was moved to keep distant from the harm.

sentences.zh: 夏，福建大水，壞延平府衛城，沒三縣田禾民舍，人畜漂流無算。

translations.literal: Summer, great flood in Fujian; the city wall of Yanping prefecture guard was damaged; fields, grain, dwellings, and people and livestock of three counties were swept away beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Summer: a great flood in Fujian damaged the city wall of Yanping prefecture guard; fields, grain, dwellings, and people and livestock of three counties were swept away beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 河南州縣多大水。

translations.literal: Many prefectures and counties in Henan had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Many prefectures and counties in Henan suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 七月，延安衛大水，壞護城河堤。

translations.literal: Seventh month, great flood at Yan'an Guard; the moat dike was damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: a great flood at Yan'an Guard damaged the moat dike.

sentences.zh: 九月，廣東衛所多大水。

translations.literal: Ninth month, many guards and posts in Guangdong had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: many guards and posts in Guangdong suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 十月，河決山東金龍口陽谷堤。

translations.literal: Tenth month, the Yellow River burst at the Yanggu dike at Jinlong mouth in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: the Yellow River burst at the Yanggu dike at Jinlong mouth in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月，渾河溢固安。

translations.literal: Year 11, sixth month, the Hun River overflowed at Gu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 11, sixth month: the Hun River overflowed at Gu'an.

sentences.zh: 兩畿、浙江、河南俱連月大雨水。

translations.literal: The two metropolitan regions, Zhejiang, and Henan all had great rain and flooding for consecutive months.
translations.idiomatic: The two metropolitan regions, Zhejiang, and Henan all had great rain and flooding for consecutive months.

sentences.zh: 是歲，太原、兗州、武昌亦俱大水。

translations.literal: That year, Taiyuan, Yanzhou, and Wuchang also all had great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year Taiyuan, Yanzhou, and Wuchang also all suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 十二年春，贛州、臨江大水。

translations.literal: Year 12, spring, great flood at Ganzhou and Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 12, spring: Ganzhou and Linjiang suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 五月，吉安江漲淹田。

translations.literal: Fifth month, the Jiang at Ji'an rose and inundated fields.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: the Jiang at Ji'an rose and inundated fields.

sentences.zh: 十三年六月，大名河決，淹三百餘里，壞廬舍二萬區，死者千餘人。

translations.literal: Year 13, sixth month, the Yellow River burst at Daming; more than 300 li were inundated; 20,000 dwellings were ruined; more than 1,000 people died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 13, sixth month: the Yellow River burst at Daming, inundating more than 300 li, ruining 20,000 dwellings, and killing more than 1,000 people.

sentences.zh: 河南、濟南、青、兗、東昌亦俱河決。

translations.literal: Henan, Jinan, Qing, Yan, and Dongchang also all had the Yellow River burst.
translations.idiomatic: Henan, Jinan, Qing, Yan, and Dongchang also all saw the Yellow River burst.

sentences.zh: 七月，寧夏大水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, great flood at Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Ningxia suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 河決漢、唐二壩。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst the Han and Tang dams.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst the Han and Tang dams.

sentences.zh: 河南八樹口決，漫曹、濮二州，抵東昌，壞沙灣等堤。

translations.literal: The Bashu mouth burst; water spread through Cao and Pu prefectures as far as Dongchang, damaging the Shawan and other dikes.
translations.idiomatic: The Bashu mouth burst; water spread through Cao and Pu prefectures as far as Dongchang, damaging the Shawan and other dikes.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月，吉安、南昌臨江俱水，壞壇廟廨舍。

translations.literal: Year 14, fourth month, Ji'an, Nanchang, and Linjiang all had flooding; altars, temples, and government offices were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 14, fourth month: Ji'an, Nanchang, and Linjiang all flooded, damaging altars, temples, and government offices.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年七月，應天大水，沒民廬。

translations.literal: Jingtai year 1, seventh month, great flood at Yingtian; commoners' houses were inundated.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 1, seventh month: a great flood at Yingtian inundated commoners' houses.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，河決沙灣白馬頭七十餘丈。

translations.literal: Third year, sixth month, the Yellow River breached at Sha Bay's White Horse Head for more than seventy zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 3, sixth month: the Yellow River breached at Sha Bay's White Horse Head for more than seventy zhang.

sentences.zh: 八月，徐州、濟寧間，平地水高一丈，民居盡圮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, between Xuzhou and Jining, level-ground water one zhang high; common dwellings all collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: between Xuzhou and Jining the water on level ground stood one zhang high, and common dwellings were destroyed throughout.

sentences.zh: 南畿、河南、山東、陝西、吉安、袁州俱大水。

translations.literal: The Southern Metropolitan Region, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, Ji'an, and Yuanzhou all had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Metropolitan Region, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, Ji'an, and Yuanzhou all suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 四年春夏，河連決沙灣。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring and summer, the river repeatedly breached at Sha Bay.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 4, spring and summer: the river repeatedly breached at Sha Bay.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，揚州潮決高郵、寶應堤岸。

translations.literal: Fifth year, sixth month, Yangzhou tidal bore breached the dikes at Gaoyou and Baoying.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 5, sixth month: a Yangzhou tidal surge breached the dikes at Gaoyou and Baoying.

sentences.zh: 七月，蘇、鬆、淮、揚、廬、鳳六府大水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the six prefectures Su, Song, Huai, Yang, Lu, and Feng all had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: the six prefectures of Suzhou, Songjiang, Huai'an, Yangzhou, Luzhou, and Fengyang were all inundated.

sentences.zh: 八月，東、兗、濟三府大水，河漲淹田。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the three prefectures Dongchang, Yanzhou, and Jinan had great floods; the river rose and flooded fields.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Dongchang, Yanzhou, and Jinan were heavily flooded as the river rose and submerged the fields.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，開封、保定俱大水。

translations.literal: Sixth year, sixth month, Kaifeng and Baoding both had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 6, sixth month: Kaifeng and Baoding both suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 閏六月，順天大水，灤河泛溢，壞城垣民舍，河間、永平水患尤甚。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, Shuntian great flood; the Luan River overflowed, destroying city walls and common dwellings; Hejian and Yongping suffered especially severe inundation.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary sixth month: Shuntian was inundated, the Luan overflowed and wrecked city walls and dwellings, and Hejian and Yongping were hit especially hard.

sentences.zh: 武昌諸府江溢傷稼。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Wuchang all had river overflow damaging the crops.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures around Wuchang all saw rivers spill over and damage the crops.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，河決開封，河南、彰德田廬淹沒。

translations.literal: Seventh year, sixth month, the river breached at Kaifeng; fields and dwellings in Henan and Zhangde were submerged.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 7, sixth month: the river breached at Kaifeng, and fields and dwellings in Henan and Zhangde were submerged.

sentences.zh: 是歲，畿內、山東俱水。

translations.literal: That year, the metropolitan region and Shandong both had flood.
translations.idiomatic: That year the metropolitan region and Shandong were inundated as well.

sentences.zh: 成化三年六月，江夏水決江口堤岸，迄漢陽，長八百五十丈有奇。

translations.literal: Chenghua third year, sixth month, Jiangxia water breached the river-mouth dike; reaching Hankou, more than eight hundred fifty zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 3, sixth month: floodwaters at Jiangxia broke the river-mouth dike and ran to Hankou along a breach more than eight hundred fifty zhang long.

sentences.zh: 五年，湖廣大水。

translations.literal: Fifth year, Huguang great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 5: Huguang suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 山西汾水傷稼。

translations.literal: Shanxi Fen River damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In Shanxi the Fen River damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，北畿大水。

translations.literal: Sixth year, sixth month, the northern metropolitan region great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 6, sixth month: the northern metropolitan region was heavily flooded.

sentences.zh: 七年閏九月，山東及浙江杭、嘉、湖、紹四府俱海溢，淹田宅人畜無算。

translations.literal: Seventh year, intercalary ninth month, Shandong and the four Zhejiang prefectures Hang, Jia, Hu, and Shao all had sea overflow; fields, dwellings, people, and livestock drowned beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 7, intercalary ninth month: Shandong and Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Huzhou, and Shaoxing in Zhejiang were all overrun by the sea, drowning fields, dwellings, people, and livestock beyond count.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，畿南五府及懷慶俱大水。

translations.literal: Ninth year, sixth month, the five southern metropolitan prefectures and Huaqing all had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 9, sixth month: the five southern metropolitan prefectures and Huaqing were all inundated.

sentences.zh: 八月，山東大水。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Shandong great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Shandong suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 十一年五月，湖廣水。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, fifth month, Huguang flood.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 11, fifth month: Huguang was flooded.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月，浙江風潮大水。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, eighth month, Zhejiang wind-tide great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 12, eighth month: Zhejiang was struck by wind-driven tidal flooding.

sentences.zh: 淮、鳳、揚、徐亦俱大水。

translations.literal: Huai, Feng, Yang, and Xu also all had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'an, Fengyang, Yangzhou, and Xuzhou were inundated as well.

sentences.zh: 十三年二月甲戌，安慶大雪。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, second month, on jiaxu, Anqing great snow.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 13, second month, jiaxu: heavy snow fell on Anqing.

sentences.zh: 次日大雨，江水暴漲。

translations.literal: The next day great rain; the river water rose violently.
translations.idiomatic: The next day came torrential rain, and the river surged.

sentences.zh: 閏二月，河南大水。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, Henan great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary second month: Henan was heavily flooded.

sentences.zh: 九月，淮水溢，壞淮安州縣官舍民屋，淹沒人畜甚衆。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the Huai overflowed, destroying official quarters and common houses in Huai'an prefecture and counties; people and livestock drowned in great number.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: the Huai overflowed, wrecking official quarters and private houses throughout Huai'an prefecture and its counties and drowning people and livestock in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月，襄陽江溢，壞城郭。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, fourth month, the Xiangyang river overflowed and destroyed the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 14, fourth month: the river at Xiangyang overflowed and destroyed the city walls.

sentences.zh: 五月，陝州大水，人多淹死。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Shanzhou great flood; many people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Shanzhou was inundated and many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 七月，北畿、山東水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the northern metropolitan region and Shandong flood.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: the northern metropolitan region and Shandong were flooded.

sentences.zh: 九月，河決開封護城堤五十丈。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the river breached Kaifeng's moat-protecting dike for fifty zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: the river breached fifty zhang of Kaifeng's protective moat dike.

sentences.zh: 十八年七月，昌平大水，決居庸關水門四十九，城垣、鋪樓、墩臺一百二。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, seventh month, Changping great flood; the Juyong Pass water-gates broke in forty-nine places; city walls, relay buildings, and beacon towers in one hundred two.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 18, seventh month: Changping was inundated, forty-nine water-gates at Juyong Pass gave way, and one hundred two stretches of wall, relay buildings, and beacon towers were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 八月，衛、漳、滹沱並溢，自清平抵天津。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the Wei, Zhang, and Hutuo all overflowed together, from Qingping reaching Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: the Wei, Zhang, and Hutuo all overflowed together from Qingping to Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年五月，河決開封黃沙岡抵紅船灣，凡六處，入沁河。

translations.literal: Hongzhi second year, fifth month, the river breached at Kaifeng's Yellow Sand Mound reaching Red Boat Bay—six places in all—entering the Qin River.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 2, fifth month: the river breached in six places from Kaifeng's Yellow Sand Mound to Red Boat Bay and poured into the Qin River.

sentences.zh: 所經州縣多災，省城尤甚。

translations.literal: The prefectures and counties it passed mostly suffered disaster; the provincial capital suffered especially severely.
translations.idiomatic: Most of the prefectures and counties along its course were devastated, and the provincial capital suffered worst of all.

sentences.zh: 七月，順、永、河、保四府州縣大水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the four prefectures Shun, Yong, He, and Bao and their counties and districts great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Shuntian, Yongping, Hejian, and Baoding and their subordinate counties and districts were inundated.

sentences.zh: 八月，盧溝河堤壞。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the Lugou River dike was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: the Lugou River dike was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，蘇、鬆、浙江水。

translations.literal: Fourth year, eighth month, Su, Song, and Zhejiang flood.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 4, eighth month: Suzhou, Songjiang, and Zhejiang were flooded.

sentences.zh: 五年夏秋，南畿、浙江、山東水。

translations.literal: Fifth year, summer and autumn, the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, and Shandong flood.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 5, summer and autumn: the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, and Shandong were inundated.

sentences.zh: 七年七月，蘇、常、鎮三府潮溢，平地水五尺，沿江者一丈，民多溺死。

translations.literal: Seventh year, seventh month, the three prefectures Su, Chang, and Zhen had tidal overflow; level-ground water five chi, along the river one zhang; many common people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 7, seventh month: Suzhou, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang were overrun by the tide—five chi on level ground, one zhang along the river—and many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，山陰、蕭山山崩水涌，溺死三百餘人。

translations.literal: Ninth year, sixth month, Shanyin and Xiaoshan mountains collapsed and water gushed forth; more than three hundred drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 9, sixth month: mountains collapsed at Shanyin and Xiaoshan and floodwaters burst out, drowning more than three hundred people.

sentences.zh: 十四年五月，貴池水漲，蛟出，淹死二百六十餘人，旁邑十二皆大水。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, fifth month, Guichi water rose; flood dragons emerged; more than two hundred sixty drowned; twelve neighboring districts all great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 14, fifth month: the waters at Guichi rose, flood dragons appeared, and more than two hundred sixty people drowned; twelve neighboring districts were inundated as well.

sentences.zh: 七月，廉州及靈山海漲，淹死百五十餘人。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Lianzhou and Lingshan sea surge; more than one hundred fifty drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: a sea surge at Lianzhou and Lingshan drowned more than one hundred fifty people.

sentences.zh: 閏七月，瓊山颶風潮溢，平地水高七尺。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, Qiongshan hurricane and tidal overflow; level-ground water seven chi high.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary seventh month: a hurricane drove the tide over Qiongshan until the water on level ground stood seven chi high.

sentences.zh: 八月，安、寧、池、太四府大水，蛟出，漂流房屋。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the four prefectures An, Ning, Chi, and Tai great flood; flood dragons emerged; houses drifted away.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Anqing, Ningguo, Chizhou, and Taiping were heavily flooded; flood dragons appeared and houses were swept away.

sentences.zh: 十五年七月，南京江水泛溢，湖水入城五尺餘。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, seventh month, the Nanjing river water overflowed; lake water entered the city more than five chi.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 15, seventh month: the Yangzi at Nanjing overflowed and lake water poured into the city more than five chi deep.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月，廬山平地水丈餘，溺死星子、德安民，及漂沒廬舍甚衆。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, sixth month, at Lushan level-ground water more than one zhang; people of Xingzi and De'an drowned; and very many Lushan dwellings were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 17, sixth month: at Lushan the water on level ground stood more than one zhang; people of Xingzi and De'an drowned, and Lushan dwellings were swept away in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 正德元年六月，陝西徽州河溢，漂沒居民孳畜。

translations.literal: Zhengde first year, sixth month, Huizhou in Shaanxi river overflow; residents and livestock swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, sixth month: the river at Huizhou in Shaanxi overflowed, sweeping away residents and livestock.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，固原河漲，平地水高四尺，人畜溺死。

translations.literal: Second year, sixth month, the Guyuan river rose; level-ground water four chi high; people and livestock drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 2, sixth month: the river at Guyuan rose until the water on level ground stood four chi high, and people and livestock drowned.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，延綏、慶陽大水。

translations.literal: Third year, ninth month, Yan'an and Qingyang great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 3, ninth month: Yan'an and Qingyang suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 五年九月，安、寧、太三府大水，溺死二萬三千餘人。

translations.literal: Fifth year, ninth month, the three prefectures An, Ning, and Tai great flood; more than twenty-three thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 5, ninth month: Anqing, Ningguo, and Taiping were inundated, and more than twenty-three thousand people drowned.

sentences.zh: 十一月，蘇、鬆、常三府水。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, the three prefectures Su, Song, and Chang flood.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Suzhou, Songjiang, and Changzhou were flooded.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，汜水暴漲，溺死百七十六人，毀城垣百七十餘堵。

translations.literal: Sixth year, sixth month, the Si River rose violently; one hundred seventy-six drowned; one hundred seventy-odd sections of city wall destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 6, sixth month: the Si surged, drowning one hundred seventy-six people and destroying more than one hundred seventy sections of city wall.

sentences.zh: 十二年，順天、河間、保定、真定大水。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, Shuntian, Hejian, Baoding, and Zhending great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 12: Shuntian, Hejian, Baoding, and Zhending suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 鳳陽、淮安、蘇、鬆、常、鎮、嘉、湖諸府皆大水。

translations.literal: The prefectures Fengyang, Huai'an, Su, Song, Chang, Zhen, Jia, and Hu all had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyang, Huai'an, Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou were all inundated.

sentences.zh: 荊、襄江水大漲。

translations.literal: The Jing and Xiang rivers rose greatly.
translations.idiomatic: The Jing and Xiang rivers rose to great heights.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月，江西大水。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, fifth month, Jiangxi great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 15, fifth month: Jiangxi suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 十六年七月，遼陽湯跕堡大水決城。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, seventh month, Liaoyang Tangdie Fort great flood breached the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 16, seventh month: floodwaters at Liaoyang's Tangdie Fort breached the city.

sentences.zh: 萬曆元年七月，荊州、承天大水。

translations.literal: Wanli first year, seventh month, Jingzhou and Chengtian great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 1, seventh month: Jingzhou and Chengtian were inundated.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，福建永定大水，溺七百餘人。

translations.literal: Second year, sixth month, Yongding in Fujian great flood; more than seven hundred drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 2, sixth month: Yongding in Fujian was flooded and more than seven hundred people drowned.

sentences.zh: 是歲，海鹽海大溢，死者數千人。

translations.literal: That year, Haiyan sea great overflow; those who died numbered several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: That year the sea at Haiyan surged inland and several thousand people died.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，淮安、揚州、徐州河溢傷稼。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengwu, Huai'an, Yangzhou, and Xuzhou river overflow damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengwu: floods along the rivers at Huai'an, Yangzhou, and Xuzhou damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，淮、徐大水。

translations.literal: Third year, fourth month, Huai and Xu great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 3, fourth month: Huai'an and Xuzhou were inundated.

sentences.zh: 五月，淮水大決。

translations.literal: Fifth month, the Huai greatly breached.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: the Huai burst its banks on a great scale.

sentences.zh: 六月，杭、嘉、寧、紹四府海涌數丈，沒戰船、廬舍、人畜不計其數。

translations.literal: Sixth month, the four prefectures Hang, Jia, Ning, and Shao sea surge several zhang; war-ships, dwellings, people, and livestock drowned beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: a sea surge several zhang high struck Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Ningbo, and Shaoxing, drowning warships, dwellings, people, and livestock beyond count.

sentences.zh: 八月，淮、揚、鳳、徐四府州大水，河決高郵、碭山及邵家口、曹家莊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the four prefectures and districts Huai, Yang, Feng, and Xu great flood; the river breached at Gaoyou, Dangshan, Shaojiakou, and Cao Family Village.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Huai'an, Yangzhou, Fengyang, and Xuzhou and their districts were inundated as the river breached at Gaoyou, Dangshan, Shaojiakou, and Cao Family Village.

sentences.zh: 九月，蘇、鬆、常、鎮四府俱水。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the four prefectures Su, Song, Chang, and Zhen all had flood.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang were all flooded.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，高郵清水堤決。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, the Gaoyou Qingshui dike breached.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 4, first month: the Qingshui dike at Gaoyou gave way.

sentences.zh: 九月，河決豐、沛、曹、單。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the river breached at Feng, Pei, Cao, and Shan.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: the river breached at Feng, Pei, Cao, and Shan.

sentences.zh: 十一月，淮、黃交溢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, the Huai and Yellow overflowed together.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: the Huai and the Yellow overflowed together.

sentences.zh: 五年閏八月，徐州河淤，淮河南徙，決高郵、寶應諸湖堤。

translations.literal: Fifth year, intercalary eighth month, the Xuzhou river silted up; the Huai shifted south; the dikes of the lakes at Gaoyou, Baoying, and elsewhere breached.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 5, intercalary eighth month: the river at Xuzhou silted up, the Huai shifted south, and dikes around the lakes at Gaoyou, Baoying, and elsewhere gave way.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，清河水溢。

translations.literal: Sixth year, sixth month, the Qinghe overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 6, sixth month: the Qinghe overflowed.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，蘇、鬆、鳳陽、徐州大水。

translations.literal: Seventh year, fifth month, Su, Song, Fengyang, and Xuzhou great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 7, fifth month: Suzhou, Songjiang, Fengyang, and Xuzhou were inundated.

sentences.zh: 八月，又水。

translations.literal: Eighth month, again flood.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: flooding struck again.

sentences.zh: 是歲，浙江大水。

translations.literal: That year, Zhejiang great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhejiang suffered a great flood.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，從化、增城、龍門溪壑泛漲，田禾盡沒，淹死男婦無算。

translations.literal: Ninth year, fifth month, the ravines of Conghua, Zengcheng, and Longmen all swelled violently; field grain entirely submerged; men and women drowned beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 9, fifth month: ravines at Conghua, Zengcheng, and Longmen swelled violently, the standing grain was entirely submerged, and men and women drowned beyond count.

sentences.zh: 七月，福安洪水逾城，漂沒廬舍殆盡。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Fu'an floodwaters passed over the city walls; dwellings swept away nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: floodwaters at Fu'an rose above the city walls and swept away nearly all the dwellings.

sentences.zh: 八月，泰興、海門、如皋大水，塘圩坡埂盡決，溺死者甚衆。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Taixing, Haimen, and Rugao great flood; ponds, embankments, and slopes all breached; those drowned were very many.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Taixing, Haimen, and Rugao were inundated, ponds, embankments, and slopes all gave way, and very many people drowned.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，淮、揚海漲，浸豐利等鹽場三十，淹死二千六百餘人。

translations.literal: Tenth year, first month, the Huai and Yang sea rose; thirty salt-fields such as Fengli were inundated; more than two thousand six hundred drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 10, first month: the sea at the Huai and Yang rose, inundating thirty salt-fields including Fengli and drowning more than two thousand six hundred people.

sentences.zh: 七月，蘇、鬆六州縣潮溢，壞田禾十萬頃，溺死者二萬人。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the six districts of Su and Song tidal overflow; one hundred thousand qing of crops destroyed; twenty thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: a tidal surge struck six districts of Suzhou and Songjiang, destroying one hundred thousand qing of crops and drowning twenty thousand people.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月，承天江水暴漲，漂沒民廬人畜無算。

translations.literal: Eleventh year, fourth month, the Chengtian river water rose violently; common dwellings, people, and livestock swept away beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 11, fourth month: the river at Chengtian surged, sweeping away common dwellings, people, and livestock beyond count.

sentences.zh: 金州河溢沒城。

translations.literal: The Jinzhou river overflowed and submerged the city.
translations.idiomatic: The river at Jinzhou overflowed and submerged the city.

sentences.zh: 十四年夏，江南、浙江、江西、湖廣、廣東、福建、雲南、遼東大水。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, summer, Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, Guangdong, Fujian, Yunnan, and Liaodong great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 14, summer: Jiangnan, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, Guangdong, Fujian, Yunnan, and Liaodong suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月，浙江大水。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, fifth month, Zhejiang great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 15, fifth month: Zhejiang was inundated.

sentences.zh: 七月，開封及陝州、靈寶河決。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Kaifeng and Shanzhou and Lingbao river breaches.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: the rivers breached at Kaifeng, Shanzhou, and Lingbao.

sentences.zh: 是歲，杭、嘉、湖、應天、太平五府江湖泛溢，平地水深丈餘。

translations.literal: That year, the five prefectures Hang, Jia, Hu, Yingtian, and Taiping rivers and lakes overflowed; level-ground water more than one zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: That year rivers and lakes overflowed across Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Huzhou, Yingtian, and Taiping until the water on level ground stood more than one zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 七月終，颶風大作，環數百里，一望成湖。

translations.literal: At the end of the seventh month a hurricane arose greatly; for several hundred li around, one glance showed only lake.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the seventh month a great hurricane struck, and for several hundred li in every direction the land lay under water as far as the eye could see.

sentences.zh: 十六年八月，河決東光魏家口。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, eighth month, the river breached at Dongguang's Wei Family Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 16, eighth month: the river breached at the Wei Family Mouth in Dongguang.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月，浙江海沸，杭、嘉、寧、紹、臺屬縣廨宇多圮，碎官民船及戰舸，壓溺者三百餘人。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, sixth month, the Zhejiang sea boiled; the yamen buildings of counties subordinate to Hang, Jia, Ning, Shao, and Tai mostly collapsed; official and common boats and war-junks were smashed; more than three hundred pressed and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 17, sixth month: the sea off Zhejiang seethed; yamen buildings in counties under Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Ningbo, Shaoxing, and Taizhou largely collapsed; official craft, private boats, and warships were smashed, and more than three hundred people were crushed or drowned.

sentences.zh: 十九年六月，蘇、鬆大水，溺人數萬。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, sixth month, Su and Song great flood; tens of thousands drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 19, sixth month: Suzhou and Songjiang were inundated and tens of thousands of people drowned.

sentences.zh: 七月，寧、紹、蘇、鬆、常五府濱海潮溢，傷稼淹人。

translations.literal: Seventh month, the five coastal prefectures Ning, Shao, Su, Song, and Chang tidal overflow; crops injured and people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: a coastal tide struck Ningbo, Shaoxing, Suzhou, Songjiang, and Changzhou, damaging crops and drowning people.

sentences.zh: 九月，泗州大水，州治浸三尺。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Sizhou great flood; the prefectural seat submerged three chi.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Sizhou was inundated and the prefectural seat stood three chi under water.

sentences.zh: 淮水高於城，祖陵被浸。

translations.literal: The Huai stood higher than the city; the imperial ancestral mausoleum was inundated.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai stood higher than the city wall, and the imperial ancestral mausoleum was flooded.

sentences.zh: 十月，揚州湖淮漲溢，決邵伯堤五十餘丈，高郵南北閘俱衝。

translations.literal: Tenth month, the Yangzhou lakes and Huai rose and overflowed; the Shaobo dike breached for more than fifty zhang; the north and south sluices at Gaoyou were both washed out.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: lakes around Yangzhou and the Huai rose and overflowed, the Shaobo dike breached for more than fifty zhang, and both the north and south sluices at Gaoyou were washed out.

sentences.zh: 二十年夏秋，真、順、廣、大四府水。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, summer and autumn, the four prefectures Zhen, Shun, Guang, and Da flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 20, summer and autumn: Zhending, Shuntian, Guangping, and Daming were flooded.

sentences.zh: 二十一年五月，邳州、高郵、寶應大水決湖堤。

translations.literal: Twenty-first year, fifth month, Pizhou, Gaoyou, and Baoying great flood breached lake dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 21, fifth month: Pizhou, Gaoyou, and Baoying were inundated and lake dikes gave way.

sentences.zh: 二十二年七月，鳳陽、廬州大水。

translations.literal: Twenty-second year, seventh month, Fengyang and Luzhou great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 22, seventh month: Fengyang and Luzhou suffered great floods.

sentences.zh: 二十三年四月，泗水浸祖陵。

translations.literal: Twenty-third year, fourth month, the Si River inundated the ancestral mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 23, fourth month: the Si inundated the imperial ancestral mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 二十四年秋，杭、嘉、湖三府大水。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth year, autumn, the three prefectures Hang, Jia, and Hu great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 24, autumn: Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou were inundated.

sentences.zh: 二十九年八月，沔陽大水入城。

translations.literal: Twenty-ninth year, eighth month, Mianyang great flood entered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 29, eighth month: floodwaters at Mianyang poured into the city.

sentences.zh: 三十年六月，京師大水。

translations.literal: Thirtieth year, sixth month, the capital great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 30, sixth month: the capital was heavily flooded.

sentences.zh: 三十一年五月，成安、永年、肥鄉、安州、深澤，漳、滏、沙、燕河並溢，決堤橫流。

translations.literal: Year 31, fifth month, Cheng'an, Yongnian, Feixiang, Anzhou, and Shenze; the Zhang, Fu, Sha, and Yan rivers all overflowed together, dikes burst, and water spread crosswise.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 31, fifth month: at Cheng'an, Yongnian, Feixiang, Anzhou, and Shenze the Zhang, Fu, Sha, and Yan rivers all overflowed together; dikes burst and water spread crosswise.

sentences.zh: 祁州、靜海圮城垣、廬舍殆盡。

translations.literal: At Qizhou and Jinghai city walls and dwellings were nearly all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: At Qizhou and Jinghai city walls and dwellings were nearly all destroyed.

sentences.zh: 六月，泰安大水，淹八百餘人。

translations.literal: Sixth month, great flood at Tai'an; more than eight hundred people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: great flood at Tai'an; more than eight hundred people drowned.

sentences.zh: 八月，泉州諸府海水暴漲，溺死萬餘人。

translations.literal: Eighth month, sea water at the prefectures of Quanzhou surged violently; more than ten thousand people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: sea water at Quanzhou and its subordinate prefectures surged violently; more than ten thousand people drowned.

sentences.zh: 三十二年六月，昌平大水，壞各陵橋道。

translations.literal: Year 32, sixth month, great flood at Changping; the bridge roads of the various mausoleums were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 32, sixth month: great flood at Changping; the bridge roads of the various mausoleums were damaged.

sentences.zh: 七月，永平、真、保三府俱水，淹男婦無算。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Yongping, Zhen, and Bao three prefectures all had water; men and women drowned beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: Yongping, Zhen, and Bao all flooded; men and women drowned beyond count.

sentences.zh: 八月，河決蘇家莊，淹豐、沛，黃水逆流灌濟寧、魚臺、單縣。

translations.literal: Eighth month, the Yellow River burst at Sujiazhuang, inundating Feng and Pei; yellow water flowed backward and poured into Jining, Yutai, and Shan County.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: the Yellow River burst at Sujiazhuang, inundating Feng and Pei; yellow water flowed backward and poured into Jining, Yutai, and Shan County.

sentences.zh: 三十五年六月，黃州蛟起，武昌、承天、鄖陽、岳州、常德大水，漂沒廬舍。

translations.literal: Year 35, sixth month, a flood dragon rose at Huangzhou; Wuchang, Chengtian, Yunyang, Yuezhou, and Changde had great floods; dwellings were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 35, sixth month: a flood dragon rose at Huangzhou; Wuchang, Chengtian, Yunyang, Yuezhou, and Changde had great floods and dwellings were swept away.

sentences.zh: 徽州、寧國、太平、嚴州四府山水大涌，漂人口甚衆。

translations.literal: Huizhou, Ningguo, Taiping, and Yanzhou four prefectures had mountains and rivers surge greatly; many people were swept away.
translations.idiomatic: Huizhou, Ningguo, Taiping, and Yanzhou had mountains and rivers surge greatly; many people were swept away.

sentences.zh: 閏六月，京師大水，長安街水深五尺。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, great flood at the capital; Chang'an Street water was five chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary sixth month: great flood at the capital; Chang'an Street was five chi deep in water.

sentences.zh: 三十七年九月，福建、江西大水。

translations.literal: Year 37, ninth month, great flood in Fujian and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 37, ninth month: great flood in Fujian and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 四十一年六月，通惠河決。

translations.literal: Year 41, sixth month, the Tonghui River burst.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 41, sixth month: the Tonghui River burst.

sentences.zh: 七月，京師大水。

translations.literal: Seventh month, great flood at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month: great flood at the capital.

sentences.zh: 南畿、江西、河南俱大水。

translations.literal: The southern metropolitan region, Jiangxi, and Henan all had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: The southern metropolitan region, Jiangxi, and Henan all had great floods.

sentences.zh: 八月，山東、廣西、湖廣俱大水。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Shandong, Guangxi, and Huguang all had great floods.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Shandong, Guangxi, and Huguang all had great floods.

sentences.zh: 九月，遼東大水。

translations.literal: Ninth month, great flood in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: great flood in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，浙江、江西、兩廣俱水。

translations.literal: Year 42, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and the two Guang all had floods.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 42: Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and the two Guang all flooded.

sentences.zh: 四十四年七月，江西、廣東水。

translations.literal: Year 44, seventh month, flood in Jiangxi and Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 44, seventh month: flood in Jiangxi and Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 四十六年八月，潮州六縣海颶大作，溺萬二千三百餘人，壞民居三萬間。

translations.literal: Year 46, eighth month, a great sea hurricane struck the six counties of Chaozhou; more than twelve thousand three hundred people drowned; thirty thousand dwellings were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 46, eighth month: a great sea hurricane struck the six counties of Chaozhou; more than 12,300 people drowned and 30,000 dwellings were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 天啓三年，睢寧河決。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 3, the Suining River burst.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 3: the Suining River burst.

sentences.zh: 六年秋，河決匙頭灣，倒入駱馬湖，自新安鎮抵邳、宿，民居盡沒。

translations.literal: Autumn of year 6, the Yellow River burst at Key-head Bay, pouring into Luoma Lake; from Xin'an Town reaching Pi and Su, dwellings were all submerged.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 6, autumn: the Yellow River burst at Key-head Bay and poured into Luoma Lake; from Xin'an Town to Pi and Su, dwellings were all submerged.

sentences.zh: 是歲，順天、永平二府大水，邊垣多圮。

translations.literal: That year, Shuntian and Yongping two prefectures had great floods; many frontier walls collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shuntian and Yongping had great floods; many frontier walls collapsed.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年七月壬午，杭、嘉、紹三府海嘯，壞民居數萬間，溺數萬人，海寧、蕭山尤甚。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 1, seventh month, day renwu, Hang, Jia, and Shao three prefectures had a sea roar; tens of thousands of dwellings were destroyed and tens of thousands of people drowned; Haining and Xiaoshan suffered especially.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 1, seventh month, renwu: Hang, Jia, and Shao had a sea roar; tens of thousands of dwellings were destroyed and tens of thousands drowned; Haining and Xiaoshan suffered especially.

sentences.zh: 三年，山東大水。

translations.literal: Year 3, great flood in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 3: great flood in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，又大水。

translations.literal: Year 4, sixth month, again great flood.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 4, sixth month: again great flood.

sentences.zh: 五年六月壬申，河決孟津口，橫浸數百里。

translations.literal: Year 5, sixth month, day renshen, the Yellow River burst at Mengjin Ford; it spread crosswise for several hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 5, sixth month, renshen: the Yellow River burst at Mengjin Ford and spread crosswise for several hundred li.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，邛、眉諸州縣大水，壞城垣、田舍、人畜無算。

translations.literal: Year 7, fifth month, Qiong, Mei, and other prefectures and counties had great floods; city walls, farmhouses, people, and livestock beyond count were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 7, fifth month: Qiong, Mei, and other prefectures and counties had great floods; city walls, farmhouses, people, and livestock beyond count were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 十年八月，敘州大水，民登州堂及高阜者得免，餘盡沒。

translations.literal: Year 10, eighth month, great flood at Xuzhou; people who climbed the prefectural hall and high mounds escaped; the rest were all submerged.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 10, eighth month: great flood at Xuzhou; those who climbed the prefectural hall and high mounds escaped; the rest were all submerged.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月，浙江大水。

translations.literal: Year 13, fifth month, great flood in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13, fifth month: great flood in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十四年七月，福州風潮泛溢，漂溺甚衆。

translations.literal: Year 14, seventh month, wind and tide at Fuzhou overflowed widely; many were swept away and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14, seventh month: wind and tide at Fuzhou overflowed widely; many were swept away and drowned.

sentences.zh: 十五年六月，汴水決。

translations.literal: Year 15, sixth month, the Bian River burst.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 15, sixth month: the Bian River burst.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，河決開封硃家寨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renwu, the Yellow River burst at the Zhu Family Stockade outside Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 15, ninth month, renwu: the Yellow River burst at the Zhu Family Stockade outside Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 癸未，城圮，溺死士民數十萬。

translations.literal: Day guimao, the city walls collapsed; several hundred thousand soldiers and civilians drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Guimao: the city walls collapsed; several hundred thousand soldiers and civilians drowned.

sentences.zh: ▲水變

translations.literal: ▲ Water transformations.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Water Transformations

sentences.zh: 洪武五年，河南黃河竭，行人可涉。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 5, the Yellow River in Henan dried up; travelers could ford it.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 5: the Yellow River in Henan dried up; travelers could ford it.

sentences.zh: 天順二年十二月癸未，武強苦井變爲甘。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 2, twelfth month, day guimao, the bitter well at Wuqiang turned sweet.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 2, twelfth month, guimao: the bitter well at Wuqiang turned sweet.

sentences.zh: 弘治十四年八月丙辰，融縣河水紅濁如黃河。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 14, eighth month, day bingchen, the river water at Rong County was red and turbid like the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 14, eighth month, bingchen: the river water at Rong County was red and turbid like the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，馬湖底渦江水白可鑑，翌日濁如泔漿，凝兩岸沙石上者如土粉，十七日乃澄。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingchen, the whirlpool water at the bottom of Ma Lake was white and mirror-clear; the next day it was turbid like rice gruel; what congealed on the sand and stones of both banks was like powdered earth; on the seventeenth day it cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingchen: the whirlpool water at the bottom of Ma Lake was white and mirror-clear; the next day it was turbid like rice gruel; what congealed on the sand and stones of both banks was like powdered earth; on the seventeenth day it cleared.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，敘州東南二河白如雪、濃如漿者三日。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, the two rivers southeast of Xuzhou were white as snow and thick as gruel for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Dingsi: the two rivers southeast of Xuzhou were white as snow and thick as gruel for three days.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月丙戌，濮州井溢，沙土隨水而出。

translations.literal: Year 15, ninth month, day bingxu, a well at Puzhou overflowed; sand and earth came out with the water.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 15, ninth month, bingxu: a well at Puzhou overflowed; sand and earth came out with the water.

sentences.zh: 正德十年七月，文安水忽僵立，是日大寒，結爲冰柱，高圍俱五丈，中空旁穴。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 10, seventh month, the water at Wen'an suddenly stood rigid; that day was severely cold; it formed into ice pillars, height and girth each five zhang, hollow with side cavities.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 10, seventh month: the water at Wen'an suddenly stood rigid; that day was severely cold; it formed into ice pillars five zhang in height and girth, hollow with side cavities.

sentences.zh: 數日而賊至，民避穴中，生全者甚衆。

translations.literal: Several days later bandits arrived; the people sheltered in the cavities; very many escaped alive.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later bandits arrived; the people sheltered in the cavities; very many escaped alive.

sentences.zh: 隆慶六年五月，南畿龍目井化爲酒。

translations.literal: Longqing year 6, fifth month, the Dragon-eye Well of the southern metropolitan region turned into wine.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 6, fifth month: the Dragon-eye Well of the southern metropolitan region turned into wine.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二十二年四月，南京正陽門水赤三日。

translations.literal: Wanli year 22, fourth month, the water at Nanjing's Zhengyang Gate was red for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 22, fourth month: the water at Nanjing's Zhengyang Gate was red for three days.

sentences.zh: 二十五年八月甲申，蒲州池塘無風涌波，溢三四尺。

translations.literal: Year 25, eighth month, day jiashen, ponds at Puzhou surged in waves without wind, overflowing three or four chi.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 25, eighth month, jiashen: ponds at Puzhou surged in waves without wind, overflowing three or four chi.

sentences.zh: 臨淄濠水忽漲，南北相向而鬥。

translations.literal: The moat water at Linzi suddenly rose; north and south faced each other and fought.
translations.idiomatic: The moat water at Linzi suddenly rose; north and south faced each other and fought.

sentences.zh: 又夏莊大灣潮忽起，聚散不恆，聚則丈餘，開則見底。

translations.literal: Also at Xiazhuang Great Bay the tide suddenly rose; gathering and dispersing were inconstant; when gathered it was more than a zhang; when open the bottom was visible.
translations.idiomatic: Also at Xiazhuang Great Bay the tide suddenly rose; gathering and dispersing were inconstant; when gathered it was more than a zhang; when open the bottom was visible.

sentences.zh: 樂安小清河逆流。

translations.literal: The Lesser Qing River at Le'an flowed backward.
translations.idiomatic: The Lesser Qing River at Le'an flowed backward.

sentences.zh: 臨清磚板二閘，無風大浪。

translations.literal: The two sluice gates of brick and plank at Linqing had great waves without wind.
translations.idiomatic: The two sluice gates of brick and plank at Linqing had great waves without wind.

sentences.zh: 三十年閏二月戊午，河州蓮花寨黃河涸。

translations.literal: Year 30, intercalary second month, day wuwu, the Yellow River at Lotus Stockade in Hezhou dried up.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 30, intercalary second month, wuwu: the Yellow River at Lotus Stockade in Hezhou dried up.

sentences.zh: 四十六年四月，宣武、正陽門外水赤三里，如血，一月乃止。

translations.literal: Year 46, fourth month, outside Xuanwu and Zhengyang gates water was red for three li like blood; after a month it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 46, fourth month: outside Xuanwu and Zhengyang gates water was red for three li like blood; after a month it stopped.

sentences.zh: 四十七年四月，宣武門響閘至東御河，水復赤。

translations.literal: Year 47, fourth month, from Xuanwu Gate's sounding sluice to the Eastern Imperial River, the water again turned red.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 47, fourth month: from Xuanwu Gate's sounding sluice to the Eastern Imperial River, the water again turned red.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十年，寧遠衛井鳴沸，三日乃止。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 10, a well at Ningyuan Guard boomed and boiled; after three days it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 10: a well at Ningyuan Guard boomed and boiled; after three days it stopped.

sentences.zh: 河南汝水變色，深黑而味惡，飲者多病。

translations.literal: The Ru River in Henan changed color, deep black with a foul taste; drinkers mostly fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: The Ru River in Henan changed color, deep black with a foul taste; drinkers mostly fell ill.

sentences.zh: 十三年，華陰渭水赤。

translations.literal: Year 13, the Wei River at Huayin turned red.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13: the Wei River at Huayin turned red.

sentences.zh: 十四年，山西潞水北流七晝夜，勢如潮涌。

translations.literal: Year 14, the Lu River in Shanxi flowed north for seven days and nights, its force like a surging tide.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14: the Lu River in Shanxi flowed north for seven days and nights, its force like a surging tide.

sentences.zh: 十五年，達州井鳴，濠水變血。

translations.literal: Year 15, a well at Dazhou boomed; the moat water turned to blood.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 15: a well at Dazhou boomed; the moat water turned to blood.

sentences.zh: 十六年，松江自五月至七月不雨，河水盡涸，而泖水忽增數尺。

translations.literal: Year 16, Songjiang from fifth month to seventh month had no rain; river water all dried up, yet the Mao waters suddenly rose several chi.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 16: Songjiang from fifth month to seventh month had no rain and river water all dried up, yet the Mao waters suddenly rose several chi.

sentences.zh: ▲黑眚黑祥

translations.literal: ▲ Black calamities and black omens.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Black Calamities and Black Omens

sentences.zh: 洪武十年正月丁酉，金華、處州雨水如墨汁。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 10, first month, day dingyou, rain at Jinhua and Chuzhou was like ink juice.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 10, first month, dingyou: rain at Jinhua and Chuzhou was like ink juice.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月，黑氣亙天。

translations.literal: Year 14, first month, black qi spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 14, first month: black qi spanned heaven.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，黑氣亙天者再。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu, black qi spanned heaven again.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renwu: black qi spanned heaven again.

sentences.zh: 二十一年二月乙卯，黑氣亙天。

translations.literal: Year 21, second month, day yimao, black qi spanned heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 21, second month, yimao: black qi spanned heaven.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年二月戊子，北方黑氣東西亙天。

translations.literal: Xuande year 1, second month, day wuzi, in the north black qi spanned heaven east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1, second month, wuzi: in the north black qi spanned heaven east and west.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，樂安城中有黑氣如死灰。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinsi, in Le'an city there was black qi like dead ash.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinsi: in Le'an city there was black qi like dead ash.

sentences.zh: 正統元年九月辛亥，未刻，黑氣亙天，自西南屬東北。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 1, ninth month, day xinhai, before the second quarter, black qi spanned heaven from southwest joining northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 1, ninth month, xinhai, before the second quarter: black qi spanned heaven from southwest joining northeast.

sentences.zh: 二年八月甲申，北方黑氣東西亙天。

translations.literal: Year 2, eighth month, day jiashen, in the north black qi spanned heaven east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 2, eighth month, jiashen: in the north black qi spanned heaven east and west.

sentences.zh: 十四年十一月己丑，晡時，西方有黑氣從地而生。

translations.literal: Year 14, eleventh month, day jichou, at the second quarter, in the west black qi arose from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 14, eleventh month, jichou, at the second quarter: in the west black qi arose from the ground.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年二月壬寅，黑氣南北亙天。

translations.literal: Jingtai year 1, second month, day renyin, black qi spanned heaven north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 1, second month, renyin: black qi spanned heaven north and south.

sentences.zh: 十月辛未，西南黑氣如煙火，南北亙天。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinwei, in the southwest black qi like smoke and fire spanned heaven north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, xinwei: in the southwest black qi like smoke and fire spanned heaven north and south.

sentences.zh: 二年四月庚辰，有黑氣如煙，摩地而上。

translations.literal: Year 2, fourth month, day gengchen, there was black qi like smoke rubbing the ground as it rose.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 2, fourth month, gengchen: there was black qi like smoke rubbing the ground as it rose.

sentences.zh: 天順五年七月己亥朔，東方有黑氣，須臾蔽天。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 5, seventh month, new moon on jihai, in the east there was black qi; in a moment it covered heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 5, seventh month, new moon on jihai: in the east there was black qi; in a moment it covered heaven.

sentences.zh: 成化七年四月丙辰，雨黑沙如漆。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 7, fourth month, day bingchen, rain of black sand like lacquer.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 7, fourth month, bingchen: rain of black sand like lacquer.

sentences.zh: 八年三月庚子，黑氣起西北，臨清、德州晝晦。

translations.literal: Year 8, third month, day gengzi, black qi rose in the northwest; Linqing and Dezhou were dim in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 8, third month, gengzi: black qi rose in the northwest; Linqing and Dezhou were dim in daytime.

sentences.zh: 十二年七月庚戌，京師黑眚見。

translations.literal: Year 12, seventh month, day gengxu, a black calamity appeared at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 12, seventh month, gengxu: a black calamity appeared at the capital.

sentences.zh: 民間男女露宿，有物金睛修尾，狀如犬狸，負黑氣入牖，直抵密室，至則人昏迷。

translations.literal: Men and women of the common people slept in the open; there was a thing with golden eyes and a long tail, shaped like a dog or fox, carrying black qi into the window lattice, going straight to the inner chamber; on arrival people fell unconscious.
translations.idiomatic: Men and women of the common people slept in the open; there was a creature with golden eyes and a long tail, shaped like a dog or fox, carrying black qi through the window lattice straight to the inner chamber; on arrival people fell unconscious.

sentences.zh: 遍城驚擾，操刃張燈，鳴金鼓逐之，不可得。

translations.literal: Alarm and disturbance spread through the whole city; people took up blades, lit lamps, and beat gongs and drums to drive it away, but could not get it.
translations.idiomatic: Alarm and disturbance spread through the whole city; people took up blades, lit lamps, and beat gongs and drums to drive it away, but could not catch it.

sentences.zh: 帝常朝，奉天門侍衛見之而譁。

translations.literal: The Emperor was holding court; guards at Fengtian Gate saw it and clamored.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was holding court; guards at Fengtian Gate saw it and clamored.

sentences.zh: 帝欲起，懷恩持帝衣，頃之乃定。

translations.literal: The Emperor wished to rise; Huai'en held the Emperor's robe; after a moment he settled.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor wished to rise; Huai'en held the Emperor's robe; after a moment he settled.

sentences.zh: 弘治五年二月己巳，北方黑氣東西亙天。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 5, second month, day jisi, in the north black qi spanned heaven east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 5, second month, jisi: in the north black qi spanned heaven east and west.

sentences.zh: 六年八月壬申，南京有黑氣，東西百餘丈。

translations.literal: Year 6, eighth month, day renshen, at Nanjing there was black qi more than a hundred zhang east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 6, eighth month, renshen: at Nanjing there was black qi more than a hundred zhang east and west.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月辛未，應州黑風大作。

translations.literal: Year 14, fourth month, day xinwei, a black wind blew greatly at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 14, fourth month, xinwei: a black wind blew greatly at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月庚子，宜良黑氣迷空，咫尺莫辨人形。

translations.literal: Year 16, second month, day gengzi, at Yiliang black qi filled the sky; at arm's length one could not distinguish a human form.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 16, second month, gengzi: at Yiliang black qi filled the sky; at arm's length one could not distinguish a human form.

sentences.zh: 正德七年六月壬戌，黑眚見順德、河間及涿，大者如犬，小者如貓，夜出傷人，有至死者。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 7, sixth month, day renxu, a black calamity appeared at Shunde, Hejian, and Zhuo; the large were like dogs, the small like cats; they came out at night and injured people, some even to death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 7, sixth month, renxu: a black calamity appeared at Shunde, Hejian, and Zhuo; the large were like dogs, the small like cats; they came out at night and injured people, some even to death.

sentences.zh: 尋見於京師，形赤黑，風行有聲，居民夜持刁斗相警達旦，逾月乃息。

translations.literal: Soon it also appeared at the capital, form red-black, moving in the wind with sound; residents at night held watch rattles to warn one another until dawn; after more than a month it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Soon it also appeared at the capital, red-black in form, moving in the wind with sound; residents at night held watch rattles to warn one another until dawn; after more than a month it ceased.

sentences.zh: 後又見於封丘。

translations.literal: Later it again appeared at Fengqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Later it again appeared at Fengqiu.

sentences.zh: 十二年閏十二月丁丑夜，瑞州有紅氣變白，形如曲尺，中外二黑氣，相鬥者久之。

translations.literal: Year 12, intercalary twelfth month, night of day dingchou, at Ruizhou red qi turned white, shaped like a carpenter's square; inside and outside were two black qi masses that fought for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 12, intercalary twelfth month, night of dingchou: at Ruizhou red qi turned white, shaped like a carpenter's square; inside and outside were two black qi masses that fought for a long time.

sentences.zh: 八年十月癸巳，杭州雨黑水。

translations.literal: Year 8, tenth month, day guisi, black rain at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 8, tenth month, guisi: black rain at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 三十七年三月，衡州黑眚見。

translations.literal: Year 37, third month, a black calamity appeared at Hengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 37, third month: a black calamity appeared at Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年四月，天雨黑豆。

translations.literal: Longqing year 2, fourth month, heaven rained black beans.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 2, fourth month: heaven rained black beans.

sentences.zh: 六年四月，杭州黑霧，有物蜿蜒如車輪，目光如電，冰雹隨之。

translations.literal: Year 6, fourth month, black fog at Hangzhou; there was a thing winding like a carriage wheel, eyes bright as lightning, hail following it.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 6, fourth month: black fog at Hangzhou; there was a thing winding like a carriage wheel, eyes bright as lightning, hail following it.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二十四年十二月辛卯，同安生黑毛。

translations.literal: Wanli year 24, twelfth month, day xinmao, at Tong'an black hair grew.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 24, twelfth month, xinmao: at Tong'an black hair grew.

sentences.zh: 二十五年二月癸亥，湖州黑雨雜以黃沙。

translations.literal: Year 25, second month, day guihai, black rain at Huzhou mixed with yellow sand.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 25, second month, guihai: black rain at Huzhou mixed with yellow sand.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十年，山東雨黑水，新鄉亦如之。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 10, Shandong had black rain; Xinxiang was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 10: Shandong had black rain; Xinxiang was likewise.

sentences.zh: 十一年，京師有黑眚，狀如狸，入民家爲祟，半歲乃止。

translations.literal: Year 11, at the capital there was a black calamity, shaped like a fox, entering people's houses as a baleful spirit; after half a year it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 11: at the capital there was a black calamity shaped like a fox, entering people's houses as a baleful spirit; after half a year it ceased.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月丁卯，黑氣彌空者三日。

translations.literal: Year 13, first month, day dingmao, black qi filled the sky for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13, first month, dingmao: black qi filled the sky for three days.
